# Fetch details for each unique song to get artist names

# Show a sample
print(songs_info[1])

steps.code:
# Aggregate song counts per artist
from collections import Counter
artist_counts = Counter()
for sid, song in songs_info.items():
    for artist in song['artists']:
        artist_counts[artist['name']] += 1

# Sort by count descending, then by name for deterministic tie-breaking
top_artists = sorted(artist_counts.items(), key=lambda x: (-x[1], x[0]))[:6]
print(top_artists)
